whyThisMatters:
M&A advisory and valuations for home-services businesses — HVAC, plumbing, roofing, landscaping, pool, pest control. Pitch: retiring owners whose kids don't want the family business. Founded 2017, US. 14 active subscriptions; profit margin on the recent snapshot 80%.

Boomer-business succession is the most boring megatrend going. The Stripe slice is a small, very steady 1k dollars/month recurring layer (likely not the success fees, which aren't visible here).

The buyer is an owner who wants to retire, and whose kids do not want the trucks. The work is a valuation and a sale for a heating, plumbing, roofing, or similar shop. The company dates to 2017. The Stripe subscriptions are a small monthly layer. A success fee, if there is one, is not in this listing. I am not treating the monthly number as the whole business.

The boring megatrend is just a lot of owners reaching retirement at the same time.
